method.production: Public HTTPS navigation and anonymous device notebook flows; no test accounts created in production
method.accounts: Isolated loopback Worker and D1 with real WebAuthn verification and virtual browser authenticators

observed_defects_fixed: Cached device reopened old ink while reporting synchronized; latest snapshot now merges with pending offline edits before the cursor advances
Sign-out disabled anonymous device notebooks; only account-bound notebooks now stay locked
Private cloud notebook Open showed neither the cached PDF nor an actionable file selection; cached originals reopen and missing originals get a visible prompt
A mismatched private PDF must leave the current document and ink unchanged
Personal library entry did not display its library; library=1 now opens it
Export and help were hidden beyond horizontal phone toolbar scrolling; the menu stays in the header
Original PDF export and shared-page erasure scope were hard to identify; source export and shared-edit confirmation were added
Expired or consumed invitations looked like network failures and blocked personal resume; preview errors now retain the notebook list and offer dismissal
Historical delta payloads exposed erased ink to newly invited members; responses now redact currently erased stroke geometry while retaining revisions and erasures
Late cache/network/file reads could reopen a superseded document; document selection generations now guard pending opens and stale notebook queries
Wrong-file feedback now appears inside the active file-selection dialog rather than behind its top-layer backdrop
Newly rendered cloud controls could look enabled during an unfinished operation and ignore quick clicks; busy state now covers replacement controls

browser_verified.private_shared_notebook_isolation: covered by core orchestration and prior two-writer browser suite

Explicit notebook connection; private PDF originals must be supplied on each device
View only, add own shared ink, or co-edit; each invitation is one use and expires after 24 hours

scope_matrix.feature: Presenter following, classroom groups, live presence and streamed ink

Add additional passkeys, recovery, safe notebook duplication/deletion/reset and visible restoration controls
Separate browser PDF bytes from mutable ink/metadata and avoid loading every PDF into library memory
Add member drafts and an explicit publication/review workflow for public lecture submissions
Implement presenter page following and classroom sessions as a distinct feature, then evaluate realtime transport
